info.title: AI Workforce Platform - Core API
info.description: Core backend of the AI Workforce Platform. All business endpoints are versioned under /api/v1 and require an OAuth 2.0 bearer access token. Organization-scoped endpoints answer 404 when the caller is not an active member of the organization and 403 when a permission is missing. Errors use RFC 9457 problem details (application/problem+json). Timestamps are UTC, ISO 8601.

stage.description: Steps with the same stage run in parallel; a later stage starts when the earlier one is resolved

coordinatorAgentId.description: COORDINATED workflows only: the coordinator, who must also be listed in agentIds

AssignTeamLeaderRequest.description: The leader must be a current member. Null clears it.

ChangeTeamDepartmentRequest.description: A null departmentId removes the association.

credential.description: Write-only secret. Stored encrypted, never returned.

ChangePositionDepartmentRequest.description: A null departmentId removes the association.

AssignEmployeePositionRequest.description: A null positionId removes the assignment.

LinkEmployeeMembershipRequest.description: A null membershipId unlinks the platform account.

AssignEmployeeManagerRequest.description: A null managerId removes the manager.

AssignEmployeeDepartmentRequest.description: A null departmentId removes the assignment.

ChangeDepartmentParentRequest.description: A null parentId moves the department to the top level.

AssignDepartmentHeadRequest.description: A null employeeId removes the head.

projectId.description: Reserved: per-project scope is not available yet and must be null.

SetAgentToolsRequest.description: Replaces the tool grants (least privilege: none by default).

SetAgentSkillsRequest.description: Replaces the skills of the agent.

AssignAgentDepartmentRequest.description: A null departmentId removes the assignment.

mode.description: PIPELINE (default, static ordered steps) or COORDINATED (a chosen coordinator agent delegates)

failurePolicy.description: FAIL_FAST (default), CONTINUE or RETRY (needs maxRetriesPerStep of at least 1)

recoveryMode.description: NONE (default) or MANUAL: a safe failure waits for a person to retry the step

stepTimeoutSeconds.description: Per-step timeout in seconds (10 or more); 0 removes it

maxParallelWorkers.description: Concurrent workers: 1 (default, sequential) to 3. Needed for parallel stages and parallel delegation

requestId.description: Optional idempotency key: repeating it never creates a second run

CreateTeamRequest.description: When a leader is given, the leader is added as the first member.

credential.description: Write-only secret. Stored encrypted, never returned.

Invitation.description: An invitation. The secret token is only sent by e-mail.

membershipId.description: Optional platform membership of this organization to link to the profile.

ApproveToolActionRequest.description: The hash of the arguments the reviewer saw. It must equal the stored one: a stale or altered request is refused.

handle.description: Unique identifier in the organization; derived from the name when omitted.

priority.description: Fallbacks only; defaults to the next free priority (1, 2, ...).

arguments.description: The arguments exactly as the provider produced them
The tool arguments as a JSON object

ToolCallStart.description: Single use: the call starts exactly once. Served with no-store.

arguments.description: The exact arguments to run, returned once

workflowRole.description: COORDINATOR when this execution is a workflow coordinator turn, otherwise null

platformActions.description: Platform-native actions offered ONLY to a coordinator turn (never MCP tools)

deadlineSeconds.description: Seconds left (step or workflow deadline) when the execution belongs to a workflow; the orchestrator must not run past it

maxDelegationsPerTurn.description: Coordinator turns only: how many workflow.delegate calls this turn may make (1 = one task at a time)

ExecutionCredential.description: Single use, only while RUNNING. Served with no-store.
